tools.name: check_cv
tools.description: For a person who wants feedback on their CV. Checks it against the same rules the CV Chap Chap builder uses: complete contact details, a summary, at least two duties and dates for every job, education, at least five skills and nothing left in [brackets]. tools.name: get_cv_format_guide
tools.description: For a person preparing a CV for a job in a particular African country. Returns how CVs are usually written for employers there: length, photo, personal details, education, referees, file format, how people apply and the main job sites. Covers the 16 countries in the input list only.

tools.name: find_cv_templates
tools.description: For a person choosing how their CV should look. Lists CV Chap Chap designs by style (professional, modern, creative, minimal) and with or without a photo, with a name, short description, id and thumbnail for each. Returns up to 12 designs.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: For a person looking for a job in Tanzania. Searches open vacancies on the CV Chap Chap jobs board, newest first, and returns up to 10 with title, employer, location, type, deadline and a link to the full advert. Covers Tanzania only.

tools.name: save_cv_draft
tools.description: For a person who wants to see or keep the CV they wrote in the conversation. Saves it as a new private draft on CV Chap Chap and returns a private link that opens it in the chosen CV Chap Chap design, where it can be previewed and edited.
